name: fingerprintjs
description_en: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library
readme_excerpt: FingerprintJS is an open-source, client-side, browser fingerprinting library that queries browser attributes and computes a hashed visitor identifier from them. Unlike cookies and local storage, a fingerprint stays the same in incognito/private mode and even when browser data is purged. FingerprintJS is available under the MIT license.
